question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. (iv).
solution:
The correct answer is '**shots**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes an incident involving gunfire, specifically during an assassination attempt.
 
• The appropriate noun should indicate the sound associated with gunfire.
 
• "**Shots**" fits well as it accurately describes the sound of gunfire.
 
• Other options ("**Alarm**", "**Music**", "**Prayers**") do not fit the context of describing gunfire in an assassination attempt.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *On the afternoon of 30 March 1981, many Americans experienced a 1. feeling__ of déjà-vu. Déjà-vu is a name given to the feeling that a person has seen or experienced an event before. Many Americans could not help having that feeling on this day. The 2. __news__ hit TVs and radios immediately. President Ronald Reagan had been shot. He was leaving a hotel in Washington DC, turned to wave at some of the people gathered to see him, and fell towards the ground. Before he could hit the ground, his Secret Service Agents 3. __whisked__ him into the car and rushed to the nearest hospital. This same story had been heard before. On 22 November 1963 President John F Kennedy was riding in a motorcade through Dallas, Texas. He smiled and waved to the crowd that had gathered to see him. 4. __Shots__ rang out from a nearby building. The President collapsed into the backseat of the car and was immediately taken to the nearest hospital. He was 5. **___________** dead at the hospital. Now, just seventeen years later, the news sounded eerily the same.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Alarm** (अलार्म): "Alarm" suggests a signal or warning sound, which does not fit the context of describing gunfire.
 
• **Music** (संगीत): "Music" refers to sound produced by singing or instruments, inappropriate for the context of an assassination situation.
 
• **Prayers **(प्रार्थना): "Prayers" suggests religious invocations, which does not match the immediate context of sounds heard during a shooting.
